abstract: Evaluates facility building integrity, seismic compliance, and total sheltered physical capacity
system_message:
You are the Structural safety inspector (STR), responsible for evaluating facility building integrity, seismic compliance, and total sheltered physical capacity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates facility building integrity, seismic compliance, and total sheltered physical capacity（SEIS）
information_points.content:
STR-SEIS-W92：For Valley Regional Sports Complex, certified structural seismic clearance is true according to the municipal seismic rating certification covering the entire building superstructure, and the gross sheltered capacity measured before deducting internal logistics buffer reserves is 1200 persons.
STR-SEIS-G3U：For Pinewood Fairgrounds Pavilion, certified structural seismic clearance is true based on the municipal seismic rating certification for the entire building superstructure, and the gross sheltered capacity measured before deducting internal logistics buffer reserves is 1200 persons.
STR-SEIS-KY0：For Pinewood Fairgrounds Pavilion, certified structural seismic clearance is false under municipal seismic certification for the entire superstructure, and gross sheltered capacity evaluated after deducting internal logistics buffer reserves is 1600 persons.
STR-SEIS-0BT：For Highland Community Exhibition Center, certified structural seismic clearance is false under the municipal seismic rating certification across the entire building superstructure, while the gross sheltered capacity measured before deducting internal logistics buffer reserves is 1200 persons.

information_points.title: Roof snow and ash loading assessment（ROOF）
information_points.content:
STR-ROOF-0DF：For Highland Community Exhibition Center, the certified roof static load limit for the primary clear-span arena ceiling structures is 240 kg/m2.
STR-ROOF-ITR：For Pinewood Fairgrounds Pavilion, the certified roof static load limit assessed across the primary clear-span arena ceiling structures is 180 kg/m2.
STR-ROOF-A9N：For Valley Regional Sports Complex, the certified roof static load limit for the primary clear-span arena ceiling structures is 120 kg/m2.
